chapter.name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

questions.stem: In the extraction of copper from its sulphide ore, the metal is finally obtained by the reduction of cuprous oxide with:
questions.solution:
Copper is obtained by auto-reduction (self-reduction) where cuprous oxide ($\mathrm{Cu_2O}$) reacts with remaining cuprous sulphide ($\mathrm{Cu_2S}$): 
$2\mathrm{Cu_2O} + \mathrm{Cu_2S} \rightarrow 6\mathrm{Cu} + \mathrm{SO_2}$.

questions.stem: In the metallurgy of copper, the slag formed during smelting in the blast furnace is:
questions.solution: In the extraction of copper, $\mathrm{FeO}$ is present as an impurity. Silica ($\mathrm{SiO_2}$) is added as a flux, reacting with iron oxide to form iron silicate slag: $\mathrm{FeO} + \mathrm{SiO_2} \rightarrow \mathrm{FeSiO_3}$ (slag).

questions.stem: In the extraction of copper, the gas evolved in the bessemerization process which causes pollution and acid rain is:
questions.solution: In the auto-reduction and smelting of copper sulfide ores in the Bessemer converter, sulfur dioxide gas ($\mathrm{SO_2}$) is released as a byproduct, which is a major contributor to acid rain.

questions.stem: In the extraction of copper, the gas evolved during the roasting of sulphide ore which causes global warming and acid rain is:
questions.solution: Roasting of copper pyrites ($2\mathrm{CuFeS}_2 + 4\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow \mathrm{Cu}_2\mathrm{S} + 2\mathrm{FeO} + 3\mathrm{SO}_2$) releases large amounts of sulphur dioxide ($\mathrm{SO}_2$) gas, which is a major contributor to acid rain.
